text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. 
...Fufu, thank you for the day off.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I heard a junior from my club 
placed in a competition.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I went to select a celebratory gift. 
Some sweets, an amulet from a shrine to 
the god of war— 
and a short letter.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Just picturing their delighted face warmed 
my heart. 
...I slept quite soundly last night.

It seems Phalaenopsis had 
a wonderful day off!
